name: Cyberpunk 2077 Mod
summary: Over 100 trigger effects for weapons and vehicles.
description:
This mod includes:
- Over 100 manually configured trigger effects for weapons and vehicles. Even supports 20 modded weapons!
- Trigger effects for turrets and brandances.
- Most of the different events and actions of the player affect the Touchpad LED and Player LED.
- Shows the battery level of your controller right in the game.
